programme.title: Captivity
programme.desc: Lors d'une mission solitaire sur Mars, le cosmonaute Chapaev est contraint d'atterrir en urgence après plusieurs incidents techniques. Piégé sur la planète rouge, il fait une découverte inexplicable qui bouleverse son existence. Devenu une légende sur Terre, parviendra-t-il à survivre ?

programme.title: Gacy
programme.desc: John Wayne Gacy est un citoyen modèle. Il ne rate jamais une occasion d'organiser une fête pour ses amis ou de se déguiser en clown pour amuser les enfants. Mais derrière cette façade trop idéale se cache un monstre. Gacy a tué 30 personnes, dont la plupart sont enterrées autour de sa maison.

programme.title: Sakra : La Légende des demi-dieux
programme.desc: Dans la Chine du Xe siècle, Qiao Feng, maître en arts martiaux et héros respecté, est accusé d'un meurtre qu'il n'a pas commis. Contraint à l'exil, il entreprend un périlleux voyage pour rétablir la vérité, affrontant de redoutables ennemis au cœur d'un conflit entre clans rivaux.

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: John, un jeune bodybuilder, se prépare jour après jour pour une compétition, les NPC Georgia Bodybulding Championships. Sa vie est un rituel, une mécanique parfaitement réglée. Concentré sur son objectif, il ne lâche rien, espérant atteindre sur scène cet instant de bonheur unique : le flow.

programme.title: La femme à cordes
programme.desc: Sébastien, un jeune homme d'une vingtaine d'années, entre dans un petit théâtre sur les conseils d'un inconnu. Gogol l'invite à regarder son show. Ce dernier s'amuse à malmener une femme devant un parterre médusé. Sébastien s'interpose, sans connaître les règles du jeu.

programme.title: On the road...
programme.desc: « On the road to paradise » raconte la rencontre improbable dans un restoroute d'une serveuse au bord de la crise de nerfs, d'un camionneur collectionneur de routiers et d'une jeune femme en pleine rupture amoureuse. Tous les trois partagent sans le savoir, le même secret : ils viennent d'assassiner un homme. Un policier entre alors dans le restaurant...

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: L'Empire dévoile tout mais ne voit rien. Ses ennemis idéalisent tout mais ne tolèrent rien. L'orgasme terrestre des putains cathodiques pour les uns. L'orgasme éternel des 70 vierges paradisiaques pour les autres. Et si la chair était seule au monde ?

programme.title: La révolution des crabes
programme.desc: Les crabes de l'estuaire de la Gironde ont un sérieux handicap : ils ne peuvent pas changer de direction et sont condamnés à marcher toute leur vie suivant la même ligne droite. Comment vivent-ils ce tragique destin ?

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Ena, femme pompière passionnée, est très investie dans son métier. Sa fascination pour le feu l'épanouie autant qu'elle impacte sur sa vie familiale.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Fugue
programme.desc: Un petit bonhomme tout à fait quelconque veut prendre soin d'une jeune pousse en la mettant au soleil. Dans un filet, il capture un nuage pour pouvoir abreuver la plante, mais celui-ci, se transformant en eau, glisse au travers des mailles. Le petit bonhomme tentera par tous les moyens de rattraper ce filet d'eau indispensable au bien-être de sa plante.

programme.title: Je suis marié
programme.desc: Un pavillon de banlieue. Une Porsche. Des bigoudis. Une cacahuète...

programme.title: Belle gueule
programme.desc: C'est l'été, le sud. Tous les jours, Sarah, seize ans, vend des beignets sur les plages avec son père. Un soir, elle fait la rencontre de Baptiste...

programme.title: Héros
programme.desc: Maxime a 14 ans. Il vit dans un petit village. Adolescent à la carrure ingrate, il peine à trouver grâce aux yeux d'Astrid, la jeune fille de 15 ans dont il est amoureux. Un matin, le village se réveille avec un immense graffiti sur le mur de l'école primaire. Si l'on ignore qui en est l'auteur, on sait tout de même quelle en est la cause : le maire sortant, unique candidat à sa succession, a enrôlé dans sa liste un militant local du front national. Les autorités ouvrent l'enquête tandis que les jeunes cherchent à connaître l'identité de leur héros. maxime voit là une belle occasion d'attirer l'attention d'Astrid.

programme.title: Tout le monde dit je t'aime
programme.desc: Marion quatorze ans, vient de recevoir un mot d'amour de son copain. Elle demande l'avis de sa meilleure amie, Joséphine. Les deux jeunes filles ne sont pas d'accord quant à l'interprétation du mot “Je t‘aime”.

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Nocturnes
programme.desc: Tes est en train de sortir de l'anorexie. La remontée à la surface est difficile, le corps est déréglé, ne répond plus de la même manière. Remanger, c'est accepter de lâcher prise, de perdre le contrôle. C'est à la fois reprendre des forces et accepter sa vulnérabilité. Mais le jeu en vaut la chandelle.

programme.title: Petit crabe
programme.desc: Jeanne vit au bord de la mer. Elle est jeune mais amère. Elle travaille à la poissonnerie parce qu'il faut bien...par dépit surement. Elvis à sa vie, son bateau. Ça lui suffit. De temps en temps, peut être plus maintenant que Kevin, son meilleur pote, est parti étudier à Lyon, il va voir Jeanne. Elle l'intrigue, le perturbe. Perturbe son monde...

programme.title: Les enfants de la nuit
programme.desc: Printemps 1944, dans un village reculé. Henriette, 20 ans, vit seule avec son grand-père Charles. Sa mère a rejoint le maquis. Henriette vit une histoire d'amour avec Josef, un jeune soldat allemand.

programme.title: Bourgeons
programme.desc: Chaque matin, c'est le rituel : Camille, une dame de quatre-vingts printemps sort de chez elle en trimbalant deux gros arrosoirs pour s'occuper de son jardin de l'autre côté de la rue.

programme.title: Petit astre
programme.desc: Alexis, 9 ans, va prendre le train tout seul pour la première fois. Au même moment, à des milliers de kilomètres, une sonde spatiale s'apprête à se réveiller.

programme.title: Rideau
programme.desc: Tom, comédien, vient de se faire quitter par son amie Angela, comédienne dans la même troupe que lui.Encore très amoureux, il tente de la reconquérir.

programme.title: Le Vent tourne
programme.desc: Un weekend d'été à la campagne. Une toute jeune fille s'éloigne de sa famille et se baigne nue dans la rivière. Elle pose ses vêtements sur une grosse pierre bienveillante. Lorsqu'elle ressort de l'eau, ils ont disparu.

programme.title: Les difficultés de la plaine
programme.desc: Marlène et Bachir travaillent en intérim dans un autodrome. Marlène a commis une petite faute dénoncée par un collègue, elle est mise à pied.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Jungle 2 Jungle
programme.desc: Michael Cromwell, brillant courtier prêt à se remarier, entreprend un voyage au coeur de la jungle amazonienne pour divorcer de sa première femme. Il découvre ainsi qu'il est le père d'un garçon de 13 ans, Mimi-Siku, élevé par les indiens. Dans un moment d'égarement il accepte de le ramener avec lui. Un beau choc des cultures en perspective !

programme.title: Cent Jours A Palerme
programme.desc: Au printemps 1982, le général Dalla Chiesa affiche de brillants états de service après avoir réussi à vaincre les Brigades rouges. Alors qu'il pourrait partir à la retraite, satisfait du devoir accompli, et mener une vie paisible aux côtés de sa compagne Emanuela, il accède à un dernier poste. Il accepte la charge de Préfet à Palerme, une ville contrôlée par la Mafia sicilienne. Peu de temps après son arrivée, le député communiste Pio La Torre est éliminé par Cosa Nostra. Révolté par ce crime et la corruption ambiante, Dalla Chiesa sera désormais la bête noire des parrains du crime. Ces derniers sont bien décidés à lui barrer la route. Lino Ventura excelle en justicier sans peur et sans reproches dans ce drame politique inspiré de faits authentiques.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: En 1947, Dalton Trumbo était le meilleur scénariste d'Hollywood, jusqu'à ce que lui-même et d'autres artistes soient emprisonnés et mis sur liste noire pour leurs convictions politiques.

programme.title: Pas un mot
programme.desc: Le psychiatre Nathan Conrad mène une vie paisible. Quand sa fille est kidnappée, il doit débloquer un code enfoui dans l'esprit dérangé de sa nouvelle patiente.

programme.title: L'Enfer du Devoir
programme.desc: Du Vietnam au Liban, le colonel Terry Childers a combattu sur tous les fronts. Vénéré par ses hommes, il est presque devenu une légende. Une tuerie au Yemen conduit le héros de l'Amérique devant un tribunal militaire.

programme.title: La Panthère Rose 2
programme.desc: C'est la panique : plusieurs trésors légendaires ont été dérobés à travers le monde. Afin de découvrir l'identité du voleur, l'inspecteur Clouseau, aussi intrépide que maladroit et gaffeur, est placé à la tête d'une équipe d'experts internationaux.

programme.title: The Samaritan
programme.desc: Après avoir purgé 25 ans de prison pour le meurtre de son partenaire Eddy, Foley est libéré, déterminé à mener une vie honnête. Il trouve un travail et tente d'aller de l'avant, mais le fils vengeur d'Eddy, Ethan, le retrouve et le pousse à participer à une arnaque à haut risque.

programme.title: L'amour en cuisine
programme.desc: Une chef parie de redresser le pire restaurant, mais l'amour du propriétaire grincheux est la clé.

programme.title: Le prince et la romancière
programme.desc: Un romancier aide un prince à trouver l'amour avant son mariage, et la réalité reflète la fiction.

programme.title: Deux chefs et un gâteau de mariage
programme.desc: Un critique gastronomique de renom se heurte à un chef qui refuse les critiques au mariage de sa sœur.

programme.title: Turbo Interceptor
programme.desc: Jake est assassiné par des voyous de quartier. Il revient sous une forme surnaturelle (Le Spectre) pour se venger.

programme.title: Le royaume interdit
programme.desc: Un adolescent américain obsédé par le kung-fu l'envoie à l'aventure en Chine, où il rejoint une bande de guerriers d'arts martiaux afin de libérer le Roi Singe.

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: Un ex-marine se fait passer pour un professeur remplaçant et découvre qu'un gang sème la terreur dans le lycée. Alors que des vies sont menacées, il entreprend de faire le ménage dans l'école en proie à la criminalité.

programme.title: The Substitute 2
programme.desc: Un mercenaire s'infiltre dans un lycée pour arrêter le gang d'adolescents qui a brutalement attaqué sa petite amie et assassiné son frère.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: La Ville fantôme est une comédie romantique pleine d'esprit(s) qui raconte l'histoire de Bertram Pincus, un dentiste irritable de Manhattan qui développe la capacité malencontreuse de voir les morts.

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: John a perdu beaucoup d'argent au jeu et échoue à Reno. Il rencontre Sydney qui le prend en pitié, lui offre un petit-déjeuner et aussi quelques astuces pour gagner de l'argent au casino. Deux ans plus tard, John devient le partenaire de Sydney.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: On retrouve ici trois générations de légendes de la comédie. Le patron de boîte de nuit Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) et son fils Quick (Eddie Murphy) se battent pour empêcher un dangereux gangster et une police corrompue de faire couler leur boîte.

programme.title: Jonathan
programme.desc: Deux jumeaux mènent une vie normale dictée par une stricte routine. L'un le jour, l'autre la nuit.

programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.sub-title: Leïla Bekhti, Antoine Griezmann et Black M
programme.desc: Leïla Bekhti, Antoine Griezmann et Black M : trois parcours inspirants vers le succès.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: La mise en scène de Destin Daniel Cretton offre plus d'intensité et d'élégance à ce Spider-Man.

programme.title: Les Super-héros : Comment ont-ils Conquis le Monde ?
programme.desc: Des comics à Hollywood, l'incroyable ascension des super-héros devenus un phénomène mondial.

programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.sub-title: Omar Sy, Florence Foresti et Stromaé
programme.desc: Les parcours de Florence Foresti, Omar Sy et Stromae, de leurs débuts au sommet de leur carrière.

programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.desc: Les destins de Squeezie, Angèle et Kendji Girac, révélés par le web, la musique et le talent.

programme.title: Hold Up
programme.desc: Plusieurs braquages opérés par des gangs différents ont lieu simultanément dans la même banque. Un des otages tente de comprendre les raisons de cette troublante coïncidence. Mais en tombant sous le charme d'une guichetière aguicheuse, la tâche ne lui est pas facilitée...

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Le baiser du serpent
programme.desc: En Angleterre, au XVIIe siècle, un architecte de jardin hollandais (Ewan McGregor, « Moulin Rouge ! ») est entraîné dans un réseau de passion et de trahison après avoir été engagé par un riche marchand.

programme.title: The Best Offer
programme.desc: Virgil Oldman, un expert en art reclus, acquiert des tableaux inestimables en trompant leurs propriétaires sur leur valeur. Engagé par la mystérieuse Claire Ibbetson pour évaluer son patrimoine, Virgil découvre des pièces mécaniques et demande l'aide de son ami Robert pour les réassembler.

programme.title: De l'Italie avec Amore
programme.desc: Ariel Moss aperçoit ce qu'elle pense être l'homme de ses rêves dans un restaurant local. Dans sa quête pour le revoir, elle rencontre Daniel, un séduisant restaurateur, qui l'aide à comprendre que le chemin vers son cœur passe peut-être par son estomac.

programme.title: Flashbacks d'un fou
programme.desc: Daniel Craig livre une performance étonnante dans le rôle de Joe Scot, une star hollywoodienne has-been à la dérive plongé dans un brouillard de sexe, de drogues et de gloire dilapidée.

programme.title: The Perfect Man(icure)
programme.desc: L'inventrice excentrique Katya s'associe au consultant en marketing charismatique et sûr de lui, Ryan, pour l'aider à vendre son appareil de manucure personnel, Phenomenails, lors du prochain Salon de la Beauté.

programme.title: Piégés
programme.desc: Dans un flashback, Ernesto, un jeune escroc, raconte comment il s'est retrouvé au bord d'un gros coup : une enfance à l'orphelinat, des cambriolages à la volée jusqu'à ce que son complice se fasse arrêter, puis l'apprentissage auprès de Lefty, un escroc vieillissant. Après quelques années de succès, ils sont rejoints par Federico, le meilleur, un véritable artiste. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Pilar, une femme du passé de Federico, refasse surface avec une proposition : arnaquer une véritable poule aux œufs d'or, une escroquerie qui pourrait les mettre à l'abri du besoin. Mais une trahison pourrait bien se préparer. Le flashback terminé, Ernesto saura-t-il tirer son épingle du jeu dans le présent ?

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Un puissant guerrier chinois tourne au crime après le meurtre de ses parents et l'enlèvement de sa sœur.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Fire Girls
programme.desc: Un tueur à gages célèbre de L.A. tombe amoureux de sa cible.

programme.title: Accélération
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus fiable, Rhona.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Un puissant guerrier chinois tourne au crime après le meurtre de ses parents et l'enlèvement de sa sœur.

programme.title: L'amour au bout du chemin
programme.desc: Pour sauver sa maison d'édition, Becca part à la Barbade avec une star de films d'action afin de retrouver un manuscrit légendaire. Leur aventure pourrait bien les mener jusqu'à l'amour.

programme.title: Deux chefs et un gâteau de mariage
programme.desc: Une critique gastronomique renommée croise la route d'un chef refusant les critiques culinaires lors du mariage de sa sœur. Entre tensions et attirance, ils devront apprendre à se comprendre avant le grand jour.

programme.title: La Chanteuse amoureuse
programme.desc: Lassée d'une vie contrôlée par son entourage, une popstar rêve de normalité. Entre son ex-mari célèbre, son manager autoritaire et un disquaire sincère, elle doit enfin choisir sa propre voie.

programme.title: Un amour inattendu
programme.desc: Piper, célèbre commentatrice sportive et mère célibataire, doit collaborer avec Erik, un père aussi têtu qu'elle, pour monter la pièce Roméo et Juliette après une affaire de harcèlement scolaire impliquant leurs enfants.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sucré salé
programme.desc: Alison reste notoirement anonyme lorsqu'elle critique des restaurants. Mais lorsqu'elle devient accidentellement virale pour avoir détruit un nouveau restaurant, son rédacteur insiste pour qu'elle fasse amende honorable en se cachant en tant que cuisinière pour le chef qu'elle a calomnié.

programme.title: Un Noël de Folie!
programme.desc: Luther Krank et sa femme Nora décident de zapper la fête de Noël, et de s'offrir à la place une croisière dans les Caraïbes. Evidemment, ça pose un problème majeur aux voisins. Si la maison des Krank n'est pas décorée, le quartier ne gagnera jamais le concours de décoration de Noël et ça, personne ne l'accepte. Entre les Krank et les voisins, la guerre est déclarée

programme.title: Cher Noël
programme.desc: Natalie anime un podcast consacré aux plus belles histoires d'amour qui font fondre les cœurs de ses auditeurs, sans avoir jamais connu la sienne. De retour dans sa ville natale pour passer les fêtes en famille et préparer son émission, elle fait la rencontre de Chris, un pompier qui pourrait bien lui faire vivre sa propre romance de Noël.

programme.title: Animal L'animal
programme.desc: Marvin est un véritable loser et le bouc émissaire de ses collègues policiers. Après avoir été victime d'un terrible accident de voiture, il est soigné par un savant qui lui greffe des organes d'animaux : si cela lui permet de sentir la drogue et de sauver le fils du maire de la noyade, il lui est de plus en plus difficile de se contrôler.

programme.title: Paul Blart: Mall Cop 2
programme.desc: Dans cette suite , Paul Blart se rend à Las Vegas accompagné de sa fille afin d'assister à une convention d'agents de sécurités. Pendant son séjour il va découvrir par inadvertance un hold-up… Seul Paul Blart peut les stopper.

programme.title: Paul Blart : Super Vigile
programme.desc: Doux et réfléchi, un agent de sécurité passe à l'action lorsque le supermarché dans lequel il travaille est la proie d'une bande de cambrioleurs très bien organisée. Il sera accompagné d'une vendeuse d'extensions de cheveux

programme.title: Sex Therapy
programme.desc: A New York, de nos jours, Adam (MARK RUFFALO) vient de rencontrer Phoebe (GWYNETH PALTROW), qui pourrait bien être la femme de sa vie, mais il est accro au sexe.

programme.title: Qui a tué Maggie Moore(s)?
programme.desc: Le chef de police Sanders enquête sur les meurtres étranges de deux femmes portant le même nom et démêle un réseau de mensonges dans une petite ville.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: New York "date doctor" Alex Hitchens (Will Smith) tries to charm gossip columnist Sara Melas (Eva Mendes) at the same time he is coaching shy Albert (Kevin James) on how to win the love of beautiful heiress Allegra Cole (Amber Valletta).

programme.title: La Fureur des Apaches
programme.desc: Un jeune officier de cavalerie est chargé d'arrêter une bande d'Apaches qui terrorisent la campagne.

programme.title: Texas, adios

programme.title: Pulse 3
programme.desc: Sept ans après l'invasion, l'humanité a fui les villes où des milliards de personnes sont mortes à cause d'une peste propagée par Internet. JUSTINE (17 ans) rêve d'une vie au-delà de son camp de réfugiés misérable, où toute technologie est interdite. Elle découvre le dernier ordinateur portable fonctionnel et l'ouvre, tel la boîte de Pandore. Quelqu'un l'attend en ligne. Et cette personne veut désespérément la rencontrer. Mais il y a une condition : elle doit retourner en ville. Animée d'un désir plus fort que la peur, Justine entreprend un voyage terrifiant vers le cœur de l'endroit où tout a commencé. Ce qui l'attend là-bas dépasse tout ce qu'elle aurait pu imaginer.

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner.

programme.title: Heroes Of The Wild Frontiers

programme.title: Wild Gangs
programme.desc: Life can be tough at times, but it gets much easier when you have friends to watch your back. Animals from across the natural world band together for all sorts of reasons. Whether it's to protect the home and family, to find food, win a mate or even go to war, it's always handy to have someone you can trust in your corner. From the classic pack of wolves stalking prey in tandem to the bullish lionfish mobs terrorising all other fish on the reef – when animals form gangs things soon get wild!

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: Mountains define some of our most spectacular landscapes, creating a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. Mountains are found on every continent on Earth, covering 22% of the planet's surface. They're a vital part of our ecosystem a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds. It's no wonder that so many cultures consider mountains sacred places: gateways to the heavens.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Stewart Island, New Zealand's third largest and southernmost island, is a place of dramatic beauty and unpredictability. Here, the Pot-bellied Seahorse father has extra responsibilities, the Octopus is both hunter and hunted, and 82 Great White Sharks need to eat, too. Standing at just 30cm and weighing only 1 kg, the Little Blue Penguin is nonetheless a swift swimmer and a determined parent.

programme.title: Faroe Islands
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Meteor

programme.title: Runaway Jury

programme.title: 16 Blocks

programme.title: The Ex Next Door

programme.title: Match Point

programme.title: Crimebusters

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan meets Gayatri and apologizes to her. He tells Gayatri that she forgave him every time and now it is his turn to return the favor. programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kuwar Singh tells Avdesh SIngh that he is willing to build a friendship with him. A cunning Avedesh spots Indravadhan and Gayatri watching him. Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Avdesh decide to play a game of chess. At first, Indravadhan claims that he would not gamble. He is then convinced by Avdesh, who claims that this game would not involve any kind of gambling. The game begins and the two contenders start betting one different things. Avdesh wins the first move and asks Raj Mata to prepare food for him for a week. Indravadhan wins the next move and asks Avdesh's horse as reward. What will Avdesh bet on? Is he playing a mind game with Indravadhan? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The game of 'shatranj' gets serious and the casual game turns into a big gamble. Indravadhan and Avdesh increases the stakes. Indravadhan tells Avdesh that he can bet anything but would never bet his wife. The game continues and in Indravadhan's absence, Kuwar singh tells Avdesh that he would give him a magnetic dice which would manipulate the numbers that he wishes. Indravadhan bets on Ameerkot and both the contenders roll their dice. Will Indravadhan finally lose Ameerkot? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan feels guilty losing Ameerkot to Avdesh Singh in gambling. Indravadhan cries for the mistake he had committed. When Gayatri tries to console Indravadhan, he apologizes to her. Later, Gayatri receives a note and she learns that someone has a solution for Indravadhan's problem. The note asks Gayatri to meet the person in the evening. To Gayatri's surprise, the person is none other than Avdesh himself. What will Avdesh say to Gayatri? How would he solve Indravadhan's problems? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Avdesh tells Indravadhan that Gayatri had come to meet him in order to find the solution for Indravadhan' s problems. Gayatri tells Indravadhan that Avdesh is lying to him. Indravadhan asks Avdesh to continue talking. Avdesh tells Indravadhan that he had promised Gayatri to return everything back to Indravadhan, if she accepts to become his queen. What will Indravadhan' s reaction be after hearing this statement from Avdesh? Keep watching the engrossing episode of ' Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj Mata confronts Sartaj and tells him that he would be getting his money shortly. Sartaj blackmails Raj Mata claiming to leak some secrets about her. Raj mata tells Sartaj that Indravadhan would never believe him. This infuriates Raj Mata, who insults Sartaj and tells him as to how low he can stoop. Raj Mata's words angers Sartaj, who slaps Raj Mata. Avdesh too reaches the scene and watches Raj Mata get assaulted by Sartaj. Will Avdesh use this scene to his advantage? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Avdesh blackmails Raj Mata as he threatens her to reveal her secret before Indravadhan. Raj Mata tells Avdesh that he has no powers to do so. She asks Avdesh to leave Raj Mahal the very next morning. Avdesh further threatens Raj Mata when he says that he has already shook the foundations of Ameerkot twice before and can do it once again. The next day, Raj Mata changes her mind and for her well being, offers the kingdom near mount Abu to Avdesh. Avdesh declines Raj Mata's offer as he says that what she is offering him is just to small for the secret that he is asked to conceal. What would Avdesh demand Raj Mata for? Keep watching the engrossing episode of Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.
